title: FabZoom
description: Simple Fabric zoom mod. More QOL features to come.
body:
# FabZoom

A lightweight, client-side only Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.11.

## Features
- **Zoom Keybinding**: Press and hold the 'C' key (configurable in the controls menu) to zoom your camera in.
- **Customizable Zoom Amount**: Use the `/zoom <percent>` command in-game to change how much it zooms! (e.g. `/zoom 200` for a 2x zoom, `/zoom 400` for a 4x zoom).
- **Client-Side Only**: Does not need to be installed on the server. You can use it on any multiplayer server!
- **Smooth Transition**: The zoom transitions smoothly for a better experience.

## Usage
Simply drop the mod into your `mods` folder along with Fabric API. Go into your game, check your Keybinds menu to ensure the Zoom key is bound to a key you like (defaults to `C`), and hold it in-game to zoom! You can also type `/zoom <percent>` in chat to adjust the zoom strength.
